steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration for the case.
Enter the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units on the line to Vendor B.
Verify the full line is selected for Vendor B and the proposal value is 10 × 90.
Open the proposal form after allocating the award.

args.goal: fill every required proposal field on the current form except Procurement Type, leave Procurement Type empty, and stop on the proposal form

steps.note: Complete the proposal form while deliberately leaving Procurement Type blank.
Attempt to submit the incomplete proposal.
Verify submission is refused and Procurement Type is identified as required.
